scopeBasis.macos: Foliole 0.7.10 changes shared desktop Sync Group behavior, PDF and image excerpt workflows, annotations, navigation, shortcuts, and the Electron runtime, so the supported macOS package is required.
scopeBasis.windows: Foliole 0.7.10 changes shared desktop Sync Group behavior, PDF and image excerpt workflows, annotations, navigation, shortcuts, and Windows host acceptance behavior, so the supported Windows package is required.
scopeBasis.linux: Foliole 0.7.10 changes shared desktop Sync Group behavior, PDF and image excerpt workflows, annotations, navigation, shortcuts, persistence, and the Electron runtime, so Linux Experimental is required.
